name: a2uiverse-composition
description: The A2UIVerse composition extension (SPEC §14): the A2A metadata contract for cross-agent UI composition, internal to the platform (orchestrator ↔ client). Two halves: the composition stamp (provenance, placement, generations) on every relayed event, and the synthesis wiring (the derived data model) on the event that paints a synthesis surface. Nothing a2uiverse-specific rides the vendor wire. Normative for every language projection; each projection's contract test asserts against this file.

compositionStamp.carriedOn: every relayed A2A event's metadata, keyed by stampKey

fields.source: Provenance: the app id the event came from.
fields.slot: Placement: the layout slot the event's surface fills; absent on the shell's own events.
fields.role: Which surface the canvas renders as the composition root: 'shell' | 'fragment'.
fields.vendorContextId: Debug only, gated by orchestrator config.
fields.vendorTaskId: Debug only, gated by orchestrator config.
fields.generations: Per-partition generation counters, keyed by namespaced surfaceId, for every surface this event touched. An integer that only goes up: bumped when an array a live ref indexes into is mutated in place (SPEC §6.2). Absent on the shell's own events — the synthesis surface is derived, not a source.

synthesisWiring.carriedOn: the metadata of the event that paints the synthesis surface, keyed by wiringKey; sent once per synthesis, never on a decline
synthesisWiring.authors: Two. The Synthesizer emits declined, reason, fields, entities and sort under synthesizerOutput (all required — optional nested arrays are dropped by the provider); the orchestrator wraps a non-declined output with computedAgainst. The model never sees generations.

synthesizerOutput.title: SynthesizerOutput
synthesizerOutput.description: Model-facing: what the Synthesizer emits. Union-free and non-recursive (structured-output constraint). Every key is required — a provider drops optional nested arrays — so a decline carries declined: true, a reason, and empty fields and entities (sort is then ignored); a synthesis carries declined: false with at least one field. The orchestrator adds computedAgainst.

declined.description: True when nothing is joinable; the reserved slot collapses and no wiring is sent.

reason.description: Why nothing was joinable when declined; empty otherwise. Journaled, never painted.

name.description: Data-model key every entity carries; a valid JSON Pointer segment.

label.description: The user-facing name. Every name the user reads on the merged surface that is not a value is a field label.

fields.description: Declared once; every entity's cells align to this list by position. At least one unless declined.

items.description: One operator over N refs, N ≥ 0. A plain vendor value is a one-argument pass-through. A cell with no refs is one no source contributes to — absent by construction: how a per-source column says that source does not carry the entity. Operators are names the shell catalog declares as functions; the contract does not enumerate them.

op.description: A function name declared by the shell catalog.

items.description: A cross-partition qualified ref: a pointer that resolves in another surface's data model.

surface.description: The namespaced surfaceId (<appId>:<surfaceId>) the pointer resolves in.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into that surface's data model. Index-addressed in this version.

cells.description: Positional, aligned to fields. Membership in one entity is the entity-resolution assertion.

sort.description: The model names the criterion (via the field's label); the runtime sorts. User-changeable.

wiring.title: SynthesisWiring
wiring.description: Client-facing: the Synthesizer's inner output plus the orchestrator's envelope. Evaluated client-side into an ordinary data model keyed `entities`.

surfaceIdNamespacing.rule: The orchestrator namespaces surfaceId on the four A2UI server→client message types and reverses it on inbound client actions. Component ids, binding paths, and catalog ids are never rewritten.
